subject: Computer Networking
title: IPsec: Securing the Network Layer
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on IPsec: Securing the Network Layer.

hook.text: TLS secures individual connections. IPsec secures all traffic between two points at the network layer.

buildup.text: IPsec encrypts and authenticates every IP packet. It works transparently — apps don't need to change.

discovery.text: It has two modes: transport encrypts the payload, tunnel wraps the entire packet inside a new encrypted one.

twist.text: Most VPNs use IPsec tunnel mode. Your device wraps all traffic and sends it through an encrypted tunnel.

climax.text: IPsec is complex to configure but powerful. It protects site-to-site links between offices worldwide.

punchline.text: IPsec encrypts everything at the IP level. Total network protection.

quiz.question: At which layer does IPsec operate?

details.summary: IPsec encrypts and authenticates IP packets at the network layer, providing security transparent to applications above it. It operates in transport mode for end-to-end protection or tunnel mode for VPN connectivity between networks, using IKE to negotiate encryption keys automatically.
details.whyItMatters: IPsec protects data at the network layer without requiring application changes. It is the foundation of site-to-site VPNs that securely connect corporate offices across the internet.
takeaways: IPsec encrypts IP packets transparently at the network layer
Tunnel mode creates VPN connections between entire networks
IKE automatically negotiates encryption keys and algorithms

faq.question: What is the difference between transport and tunnel mode?
faq.answer: Transport mode encrypts only the IP packet payload, protecting data between two hosts while leaving IP headers visible. Tunnel mode encrypts the entire original IP packet and wraps it in a new IP header, creating a secure tunnel between networks. VPNs use tunnel mode.

faq.question: How does IPsec relate to VPNs?
faq.answer: Most site-to-site VPNs use IPsec in tunnel mode to create encrypted connections between office networks over the internet. The tunnel makes remote networks appear directly connected. IPsec VPNs encrypt all traffic between sites transparently, regardless of the applications generating it.
